style: Hand-painted 2D animated-film background art: soft painterly brushwork, warm natural light, gentle atmospheric perspective, muted earthy palette (paper beige, sage green, teal-grey water, terracotta roofs), clean readable shapes, cinematic and calm. Rural northern Vietnam. Every image in this set must share exactly this style.

assets.prompt: Wide establishing shot, eye-level, fixed camera, 16:9 framing. A calm wide river crosses the whole frame horizontally through the middle. Far bank: a thin strip of wild grass and a few trees, soft limestone mountains in the haze behind. Near bank (bottom third): packed earth and wild grass. One large smooth grey boulder sits at the water's edge on the near bank, slightly right of center (its center at about 68% from the left and 72% from the top), roughly one-eighth of the frame wide. Open empty ground in front of the boulder for people to walk along. Morning light. No people, no animals, no buildings.

Same place many decades later, early 1990s. On the far bank: a small Vietnamese river town — rows of low houses with terracotta tile roofs and cream walls, a few trees, wooden power poles with sagging wires. On the far left, a simple concrete bridge crosses the river toward the viewer. On the near bank, a worn packed-earth footpath runs left-to-right in front of the boulder. Warm late-afternoon light. Still no people.

Character design sheet on a plain off-white background: a 7-year-old Vietnamese girl with short black bob hair, wearing a bright orange-red raincoat (#D9622B) with the hood down, navy trousers and small brown shoes. Show her full body three times: front view, side view facing right, back view. Simple, readable, same painterly style. No text labels.
The same girl from the reference sheet, full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking briskly: left leg forward, right leg back, arms swinging.
The same girl from the reference sheet, full body, side view facing RIGHT, mid-stride passing pose: legs close together, one knee slightly bent, arms near her sides.

The same girl from the reference sheet, crouching down on her heels, side view facing RIGHT, reaching her right hand forward and slightly up as if gently touching a big rock in front of her, curious expression.

The same girl from the reference sheet, sitting on a ledge seen from the side, facing RIGHT, legs dangling down in front, hands resting on the ledge beside her hips, relaxed and happy, looking out ahead.
A Vietnamese man from the early 1990s, full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking: short-sleeved white shirt, grey trousers, sandals, black hair.
A Vietnamese woman from the early 1990s, full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking with a conical hat (nón lá), light brown áo bà ba and dark trousers, carrying a woven basket on one arm.
A Vietnamese young man from the early 1990s riding an old black city bicycle, full body with the whole bicycle, side view facing RIGHT, blue shirt, dark trousers.

Same place, centuries ago, the first settlers: on the far bank ONE small thatched-roof hut with earthen walls, a small clump of bamboo beside it and a thin wisp of cooking smoke. A faint footpath is beginning to form on the near bank in front of the boulder. Soft morning light. No people.

Same place a few generations later: the far bank is now a traditional northern Vietnamese village — many thatched-roof houses with earthen walls, tall bamboo hedges, a few areca palms, a small communal house (đình) with a curved roof. The near-bank footpath is now well worn packed earth. Warm midday light. No people.

Same place years later after the village moved away: the thatched houses on the far bank are abandoned — roofs sagging and collapsed, walls crumbling, overgrown with grass and vines, bamboo grown wild. The near-bank path is fading under grass. Quiet overcast light. No people.

Same place in the present day: behind the old tile-roof houses on the far bank rise a few modern mid-rise apartment buildings and a distant city skyline; the bridge is now a wider modern bridge. On the near bank the river edge is reinforced with a low stone embankment and a simple metal railing — the railing stops on both sides of the boulder, leaving a gap so the boulder remains untouched. Two street lamps on the near bank at the left. The footpath is now paved with grey tiles. Soft late-afternoon light. No people.

The SAME person as the girl in the reference sheet (same face shape, black hair, warm skin), now about 15 years old, taller and slimmer, shoulder-length black hair, wearing a faded orange-red jacket (#D9622B) over a white school shirt and dark trousers, sitting on a ledge seen from the side facing RIGHT, legs dangling, reading a book on her lap.

The SAME person as the girl in the reference sheet (same face shape, black hair, warm skin), now an elderly grandmother about 75 years old with silver-white hair in a bun, wearing a muted brick-orange cardigan (#8A5A44) and dark trousers, sitting on a ledge seen from the side facing RIGHT, legs dangling, and beside her on her left sits her 6-year-old granddaughter in a small bright orange-red raincoat (#D9622B), both looking out ahead together, the grandmother's arm around the child.

The same teenage girl as in the first reference (about 15, shoulder-length black hair, orange-red jacket, dark trousers, brown shoes), full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking: left leg forward, right leg back, arms swinging gently, holding a small book in one hand.

The exact same teenage girl as the reference, same clothes and proportions, full body, side view facing RIGHT, mid-stride passing pose: legs close together, one knee slightly bent, arms near her sides.

The same woman as the girl in the second reference, now a young mother about 32 years old (black hair tied back, rust-orange jacket #B55A36, dark trousers), full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking while holding the hand of her 6-year-old daughter who walks beside her in a small bright orange-red raincoat (#D9622B) — the child looks like the girl in the second reference. Left legs forward.
The exact same mother and daughter as the reference, same clothes and proportions, full body, side view facing RIGHT, holding hands, mid-stride passing pose: legs close together.

A northern Vietnamese village woman from the 1930s, full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking with a conical hat (nón lá), brown áo tứ thân, black skirt, carrying a bamboo shoulder pole (đòn gánh) with two woven baskets of vegetables.
A northern Vietnamese farmer from the 1930s, full body, side view facing RIGHT, walking barefoot, brown peasant clothes with rolled trousers, a conical hat, carrying a hoe over his shoulder.

A small traditional northern Vietnamese village wedding procession from the 1930s, side view walking to the RIGHT in a single line: an elder leading holding a red lacquered tray covered with red cloth, the groom in a blue áo dài and khăn xếp, the bride in a red áo dài with a conical hat, two relatives carrying round red gift boxes. Full bodies, all feet on the same ground line.

A northern Vietnamese village family leaving their home in the 1950s, side view walking to the LEFT in a line: a man carrying a shoulder pole with bundles, a woman with a conical hat carrying a cloth bundle, a child holding a small chicken basket, an old woman with a walking stick. Tired but hopeful. Full bodies, all feet on the same ground line.

A small traditional wooden sampan (thuyền nan / flat wooden boat) on its own, side view facing RIGHT, with one fisherman in a conical hat standing at the back rowing with a long oar, a folded fishing net in the boat. No water drawn.
